_comment: Cursor — .cursor/mcp.json in the repo (or ~/.cursor/mcp.json globally). A remote server is a bare `url`; Cursor picks the transport from the endpoint. Rules are .cursor/rules/*.mdc with `globs:` and `alwaysApply:` frontmatter, which is a different format from .agents/rules/, so bootstrap.sh generates the .mdc wrappers from the shared rule files rather than duplicating their text. NEEDS A MANUAL CHECK on the installed Cursor: whether this build reads SKILL.md skills, and whether it reads AGENTS.md at the repo root in addition to .cursor/rules.
